title: UCC Article 9 Enforcement in Commercial Loan Servicing | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: How UCC Article 9 remedies connect to commercial loan servicing — early breach detection, documented trails, and enforcement triggers for institutional portfolios.
h1: UCC Article 9 enforcement starts in the servicing layer
lede: Remedies only help if breach is noticed early and the trail is clean. For special-situations and CRE books, timing is the product — not the lawsuit after the fact.

sections.heading: Default is a process problem first
paragraphs: When delinquency and covenant signals live in quarterly packs, workout counsel arrives late. Wiring enforcement triggers into servicing shortens the gap between missed payment and structured remediation.

sections.heading: What we operationalize
paragraphs: Delinquency tracking from first miss through structured recovery workflows, documentation suitable for counsel, and Article 9-aware escalation where applicable on commercial (non-consumer) collateral structures.

sections.heading: Scope boundaries
paragraphs: We operate as an institutional B2B servicing platform for commercial real estate and business/commercial loans. We do not service consumer residential mortgages or retail lending products.

faqs.a: No. We operate servicing and enforcement-trigger workflows. Legal strategy remains with your counsel; we provide the operational trail and escalation timing.

faqs.q: Is this only for non-performing loans?
faqs.a: Performing books benefit from early detection. Special-situations and NPL portfolios benefit most from tight breach-to-action timing.
